description: This file defines the Download model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to retrieve download records, count total downloads, and add download access reports, primarily for customer downloads associated with orders.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: A model class handling download-related database operations for customer orders within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves a specific download record based on download ID, filtered by customer and order statuses.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Retrieves a list of download records for the current customer, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Returns the total count of download records for the current customer and filters.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Creates a new report entry for a download access, logging IP and country.
